scenes.heading: an agent pays
scenes.narration: A buyer. An agent buys. In testnet USDC. Basis Theory holds the key.

scenes.heading: separate roles, one payment
scenes.narration: The buyer. Its agent shops. The spend service decides. Through fixed tools. It checks policy. Keeps a ledger. Seals approved intents. Basis Theory checks five fixed rules. Then accesses the key. The merchant requests payment. A facilitator submits it. The chain settles.

scenes.heading: the order
scenes.narration: The agent orders. One and a half USDC. Then asks to pay. Payment required.

scenes.heading: the decision
scenes.narration: The service checks the terms. Saves a nonce and expiry. Then seals the intent.

scenes.heading: inside basis theory
scenes.narration: The sealed intent enters Basis Theory. The signer checks the seal. Then all five fixed rules. Only then can it sign. The signature leaves. The key stays.

scenes.heading: settlement
scenes.narration: The service checks the signature. Merchant records the claim. Verified. Submitting. USDC moves on chain. Confirmed. The receipt returns.

scenes.heading: the refusal
scenes.narration: A separate request names an unlisted payee. The seal passes. The payee fails. Refused. No signature. No transfer.

scenes.heading: same order, same receipt
scenes.narration: Pay the same order again. The ledger finds its receipt. One transfer. Same receipt.

scenes.heading: who holds what
scenes.narration: Wallet key: Basis Theory. Seal key: shared authentication. Invoker: invoke only. Management: operator only. Provisioner: one-time use. Agent: no buyer keys. Merchant: no buyer keys.

scenes.heading: policy, signature, settlement
scenes.narration: Policy decides. The signer signs. The chain settles.
